elements_selected.content: Extend the existing `zetl check` command to include SPL diagnostics alongside dead links, orphans, and syntax errors. Add --spl flag to filter to SPL diagnostics only. SPL diagnostics include: 1) Parse errors (malformed SPL syntax) with file/line/column/message, 2) Undefined rule labels in superiority relations (warning), 3) Duplicate rule labels across documents (warning with both locations), 4) Body literals that appear nowhere as a head or fact (warning, possible typo). Integrate into existing check output format — add spl_diagnostics array to JSON, add SPL section to table. The existing --fail-on flag applies to SPL diagnostics (errors count as errors, warnings as warnings). Per CON-004 extended.
